categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: internet acceleration services focused on network and mobile game acceleration, and mobile internet software advertising display services along with paid subscription services. The internet acceleration segment includes products like PC and mobile game accelerators, while the advertising segment involves personalized tool applications and casual games for mobile platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes intelligent network routing, cloud acceleration platforms (SCAP), and smart acceleration algorithms to optimize data transmission for gaming applications. It integrates acceleration modules into game clients, mobile ROMs, chipsets, and routers. The technology stack includes PaaS and SaaS platforms, patented backbone network acceleration, Wi-Fi acceleration, and 4G/5G QoS acceleration technologies, supported by agile and iterative R&D processes leveraging AI and AIGC for algorithm and service optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual gamers, especially heavy and competitive players of PC and mobile games, as well as game operators and platform partners. The company also serves advertisers and mobile app users through its advertising and subscription services. The end markets are mainly the online gaming industry and mobile internet application users, both domestically in China and internationally.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with over 99% of revenue generated domestically. It also has overseas operations and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore, focusing on advertising services and network acceleration. Key overseas entities include subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore, with financial reporting in USD and HKD reflecting international business activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the internet service supply chain, providing network acceleration services and software-based advertising platforms directly to end users and business partners. It collaborates with game developers, hardware manufacturers, and platform operators, positioning itself as a service provider enhancing network performance and user experience.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on expanding its intelligent network services ecosystem globally, deepening vertical industry applications, and innovating in multi-scenario intelligent network adaptation. R&D priorities include continuous enhancement of network acceleration algorithms, integration of AI and AIGC technologies, and development of new products along the gaming industry value chain. The company also emphasizes strengthening partnerships with leading game and hardware manufacturers and expanding market coverage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through subscription fees for network acceleration services (B2C, B2B2C, and B2B models), advertising service fees from mobile internet software, and paid subscriptions within mobile applications. The company collects prepaid fees from individual users and postpaid fees from enterprise clients, with advertising revenues derived from partnerships with global ad platforms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player and industry leader in China's PC and mobile game acceleration market, holding a strong competitive position in terms of market share, user base, technology, and operational capabilities. It maintains close cooperation with major game developers and hardware manufacturers, leveraging its recognized brand and advanced technology to sustain competitive advantages. Specific competitors are not named in the report.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 297.4 million, a 19.76% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 20.5 million, down 30.12%. The company experienced a decline in prepaid B2C business but growth in B2B services. Total assets were about RMB 897 million with a slight decrease year-over-year. R&D expenses accounted for nearly 20% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment despite revenue contraction.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its intelligent network acceleration technology that significantly improves gaming experience by reducing latency, login difficulties, and disconnections, which is critical for competitive and real-time games. Its SCAP platform offers scalable, stable, and rapid cloud acceleration services with patented technologies. The company also differentiates through its extensive user base of high-value competitive gamers and its integrated ecosystem involving game developers, hardware manufacturers, and platform operators.
